## Give a talk {#speak}

We'd love to hear how you use R, at any level. Every talk is welcome:

- **Lightning talks** (5 minutes): one idea, one package, one trick.
- **Full talks** (20–30 minutes): a project, an analysis or a method.
- **Workshops** (1–3 hours): hands-on teaching.

First-time speakers are especially welcome, and we'll gladly help you prepare.

[Propose a talk]({{< var links.talk-form >}}){.btn .btn-primary}

## Write for the blog {#write}

Share a tutorial, a project write-up, an event recap or a story about learning R. Posts can be in English or Kiswahili.

Send your draft to [{{< var contact.email >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.email >}}), or, if you know Git, open a pull request on [our GitHub]({{< var links.github >}}) with a new folder in `posts/`.

## Volunteer {#volunteer}

The community is run by volunteers. We'd love help with:

- planning and running events;
- teaching or assisting at workshops;
- social media and design;
- this website.

Even an hour a month makes a difference. Email [{{< var contact.email >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.email >}}) to get started.

## Partner with us {#partner}

Universities, companies, research institutes, NGOs and innovation hubs can support the community by:

- **hosting** a meetup or workshop at your venue;
- **sponsoring** refreshments, internet or prizes;
- **sharing** internships, jobs and data challenges with members.

Get in touch at [{{< var contact.email >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.email >}}).

## Contact

For anything else, email [{{< var contact.email >}}](mailto:{{< var contact.email >}}).
